summary.text: The last-named suitor in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium of Penelope's wooers — attested only in Epitome 7.27 among those who came against Odysseus' house.

story.text: Apollodorus closes his long list of suitors with Ceraus, after Polypoetes and the many wooers who devoured Odysseus' substance in Ithaca.
